gate: B: CANCELLED -> lease/claim cycle -> worker must never invoke Chronon again
summary: A job cancelled while running is never claimed again and never requeued by lease expiry: after the in-flight claim (attempt 1) the job was cancelled, the late complete/fail reports were rejected (409), and across 3 full lease/claim cycles every claim returned 204 and the attempt count stayed frozen at 1. A pending job cancelled before any claim was never claimable and kept attempts=0 (Chronon never invoked).
mechanism: New POST /jobs/{id}/cancel in the RenderingGen queue. Cancelled is a terminal state: ClaimState only selects pending/rendered rows and RequeueExpired only touches running/finalizing rows, so a cancelled job can never be re-claimed or re-queued. An in-flight attempt is closed as 'cancelled' in the render_attempts ledger (migration 020_cancel_attempt_status.sql) with a JOB_CANCELLED render_event; attempts are never incremented by cancellation.
